title: navi-testing scenarios
description: Schema for scenarios.yaml. A top-level array of scenario objects.

agent.description: Known agent types (observed in dev) plus 'none'. Add new real agents here. A typo will fail validation; that's the point.

id.description: id must be T-<NNN>, sequential from T-001 (e.g. T-001, T-002)

agents.description: Agent type name(s); not enum-checked, any string allowed. [none] asserts no delegation and must be the only element.

in_thread_of.description: Optional. Run this scenario as a threaded reply under the message sent for the referenced scenario id (same Slack thread) instead of a fresh top-level message — for multi-turn / context-continuation tests. The referenced id MUST be defined EARLIER in this file (a scenario can only thread under one that already ran). Cross-checked by validate_scenarios.py.

allOf.description: 'none' must stand alone (no delegation cannot coexist with a named agent).
